title: Forklift charging bay
body:
# Forklift charging bay

## Profile
The charging bay at the north dock has twelve chargers; four more were fitted during the March refit, which brought it up from eight. Each charger serves one truck at a time and needs about six hours for a full charge.

## Owners
Facilities looks after the chargers. The night shift lead runs the plug-in rota.

title: Charge forklift trucks overnight in the north bay
body:
# Charge forklift trucks overnight in the north bay

## Context
Charging during the day took trucks off the floor in peak picking hours.

## Decision
Every truck is plugged in when the second shift ends and charges overnight in the bay described in [[area/forklift-charging-bay]]. The bay has eight chargers, so no truck waits for a free plug.

## Consequences
The night shift lead owns the plug-in rota. Trucks that miss the plug-in window start the morning on a partial charge.
